scientific_integrity: The kernel and its approximation order are classical; the claimed contribution is the sharp BV stability factor and exact four-tap comparison. The displayed unrestricted bound has an analytic proof, not an empirical certificate.
scientific_limitations: Applies to real bi-infinite uniformly sampled data of finite discrete variation and exactly the even six-tap support-three Keys cubic-convolution kernel. No result for arbitrary fourth-order interpolation kernels, nonuniform meshes, boundary closures, or two-dimensional image total variation. The printed 1981 Keys paper is known at month precision, while the dated openly released 2001-02-21 source is the earliest independently day-verified public archival lead used in chronology; this is not a claim of 2001 invention. Historical mathematical priority remains qualified pending unindexed literature.
title: Sharp bounded-variation cost of fourth-order Keys cubic convolution
